title: EvalBundle
description: The evals selected for one strategy candidate (HAR-129 section 9). Routing is part of the record: every selected eval says why it is relevant here, and an eval judged not relevant has no result. Verdicts are listed one by one, never collapsed into a score. Each EvalResult also lives in eval_runs under (agent_run_id, draft_index); the bundle is the snapshot Slack and web render.

selected_eval_suite.description: The eval suite the router selected from the transition status, the state and the action (contracts/transitions/routing.v1.json); null when no suite applies. Suite-governed semantic evals outside it are listed as not_relevant.

candidate_policy.description: The deterministic transition policy applied to the candidate (HAR-128): while the transition is CANDIDATE or UNRESOLVED an expansion CTA (by its label, or by the text of an external action: a mislabelled candidate is restricted and the mismatch recorded as expansion_label_mismatch), commercial escalation, broad executive outreach or pricing push is restricted, needs human review and cannot be Ghost's preferred candidate. Null when no transition policy applied.

relevance_reason.description: Why this eval was (or was not) relevant to this candidate and state.

verdict.description: The EvalResult verdict, or not_relevant when the eval did not run. unknown (older spelling: abstain) is kept: an evaluator that ran and could not judge is not the same as one that does not apply.

result.description: The full EvalResult (evidence_refs, suggested_correction, model, blocking, reason live there); null exactly when verdict is not_relevant.

metadata.description: Cost and latency of producing the judgment (the model name is result.model).
